text: {"assertions":["A partial upload bug in storage/blob/uploader.rs was debugged on 2026-02-06, affecting sessions authenticated through an OAuth provider.","The bug manifested as a final part of an upload that was never acknowledged by the server.","The root cause was a cache entry that was not invalidated when data was written to storage.","The fix invalidated the cache entry within the write transaction, implemented in PR #1396 on branch fix/partial-upload-1.","The bug could be reproduced by uploading a 40 MB fixture file over a throttled network connection.","The storage system's uploader component is implemented in Rust.","A module test block in storage/blob/uploader.rs was used to verify the fix.","The fix reduced test failures from 50 per 100 runs to zero failures."]}
